# Can I afford to buy this business?

> Free calculator for buying a small business: enter the asking price, SDE and financing and see DSCR, cash needed at close, owner take-home, the highest price that still clears a lender's coverage floor and what happens if earnings fall. Private, runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
